mapper.insert: INSERT INTO routine_cycle (routine_seq_no, member_seq_no, cycle_number, start_ymd, end_ymd, target_value, daily_limit) VALUES(#{routineSeqNo}, #{memberSeqNo}, #{cycleNumber}, #{startYmd}, #{endYmd}, #{targetValue}, #{dailyLimit})
mapper.update: UPDATE routine_cycle SET target_value = #{targetValue}, daily_limit = #{dailyLimit}, current_achieved_value = #{currentAchievedValue}, status = #{status}, change_at = NOW() WHERE seq_no = #{seqNo}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM routine_cycle WHERE routine_seq_no = #{routineSeqNo} ORDER BY cycle_number DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.title, r.routine_type, rc.target_value, rc.current_achieved_value FROM routine_cycle rc INNER JOIN routine r ON rc.routine_seq_no = r.seq_no WHERE rc.member_seq_no = #{memberSeqNo} AND rc.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' ORDER BY r.create_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE routine_cycle SET current_achieved_value = ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(dl.achieved_value), 0) FROM daily_log dl WHERE dl.cycle_seq_no = routine_cycle.seq_no AND dl.status = 'DONE' ), change_at = NOW() WHERE seq_no = ( SELECT cycle_seq_no FROM daily_log WHERE seq_no = #{dailyLogSeqNo} )
